title: Secret Room in house with slides
content: Just woke up from a dream and remembered I’d been there before. Inside my house there’s a little tiny room with 2 slides like you’d see in a playground, red plastic and blue plastic that shoot out of the walls into other areas of the house. The room feels a bit secretive, like the only way to even notice the slides are there in the first place is to access this room. I remember walking in the room in my dream ( I went this time bc there was a few retro arcade machines in there too which I haven’t seen before) and being like “I need to remember to show my friend this when he comes over, he hasn’t seen the slide room yet.” So weird how I have that thought of “needing to show someone this area bc they haven’t seen it yet” in a dream bc when I wake up and remember saying something like that it really brings back vivid memories of other dreams where I have been there before.
